board1_product_teardown.name: Sume vs Higgsfield vs Open-DreamFlow Product Map
board1_product_teardown.userIntent: Compare Sume.com 0%-markup single-turn flow, Higgsfield.ai Soul ID and DoP subscription wrapper, and Open-DreamFlow Spatial DAG with 1-click hybrid credits and wallet.
board1_product_teardown.mermaidSyntax:
flowchart LR
    subgraph sumeFlow ["Sume.com - 0% Markup Flat Studio"]
        sumeWallet["$5 Prepaid Wallet"]
        sumeComposer["Single Prompt Composer"]
        sumePick["Seedance or Kling Pick"]
        sumeRender["Single-Turn Output"]
        sumeGap["No Spatial DAG"]
        sumeWallet --> sumeComposer --> sumePick --> sumeRender --> sumeGap
    end

    subgraph higgsFlow ["Higgsfield.ai - Subscription Cinema Wrapper"]
        higgsSub["$19-$129 Monthly Tier"]
        higgsSoul["Soul ID Face Lock"]
        higgsDop["DoP Camera Presets"]
        higgsWrap["Kling or Wan Wrapper"]
        higgsGap["Expiring Credit Wall"]
        higgsSub --> higgsSoul --> higgsDop --> higgsWrap --> higgsGap
    end

    subgraph dreamFlow ["Open-DreamFlow - Beat-Both Spatial Studio"]
        odfAuth["1-Click Browser or BYOK"]
        odfWallet["$5 Non-Expiring Wallet"]
        odfSoul["Soul ID Vault"]
        odfDag["Spatial Node DAG"]
        odfDop["3D DoP Camera Rig"]
        odfNle["Multi-Track NLE Export"]
        odfAuth --> odfDag
        odfWallet --> odfDag
        odfSoul --> odfDag
        odfDag --> odfDop --> odfNle
    end

    sumeGap -.->|"Solved by"| odfDag
    higgsGap -.->|"Solved by"| odfAuth

    style sumeFlow fill:#C2E5FF,stroke:#3DADFF
    style higgsFlow fill:#FFECBD,stroke:#FFC943
    style dreamFlow fill:#CDF4D3,stroke:#66D575
    style sumeGap fill:#FFCDC2,stroke:#FF7556
    style higgsGap fill:#FFCDC2,stroke:#FF7556

board2_cloud_gpu_r2_infra.name: Open-DreamFlow Scale-Up Cloud and GPU Infrastructure
board2_cloud_gpu_r2_infra.userIntent: Map commercial cloud, realtime Durable Objects, Temporal DAG queue, double-entry ledger, wholesale APIs, H100 GPU cluster, and Cloudflare R2 zero-egress media CDN.
board2_cloud_gpu_r2_infra.mermaidSyntax:
flowchart LR
    subgraph client ["Creator Clients"]
        webCanvas["Spatial WebGL Canvas"]
        chromeBridge["Chrome Credit Bridge"]
    end

    subgraph gateway ["Edge and Realtime"]
        cfEdge["Cloudflare Pages API"]
        durableRooms["Durable Objects Sync"]
    end

    subgraph service ["Core Control Plane"]
        apiGateway["Fastify API Router"]
        walletEngine["Double-Entry Wallet"]
        dagWorker["Temporal DAG Worker"]
        gpuRunner["H100 GPU Cluster"]
        mediaWorker["FFmpeg NVENC Proxy"]
    end

    subgraph async ["Job Queues"]
        temporalQueue["Temporal Task Queue"]
    end

    subgraph datastore ["Storage and State"]
        postgresDb["Postgres Ledger DB"]
        vaultKms["BYOK KMS Vault"]
        r2Storage["Cloudflare R2 CDN"]
    end

    subgraph external ["Tier-1 Model APIs"]
        stripeBilling["Stripe Checkout"]
        tierOneApis["Kling Seedream Veo APIs"]
        audioApis["ElevenLabs Sync APIs"]
    end

    webCanvas -->|"HTTPS"| cfEdge
    webCanvas <-->|"WebSocket"| durableRooms
    chromeBridge <-->|"Bridge WS"| durableRooms
    cfEdge -->|"Routes API"| apiGateway
    durableRooms -->|"Dispatches"| apiGateway
    apiGateway -->|"Holds Credits"| walletEngine
    apiGateway -->|"Reads Keys"| vaultKms
    walletEngine -->|"Atomic Ledger"| postgresDb
    walletEngine -.->|"Stripe: Topups"| stripeBilling
    apiGateway -.->|"Enqueues DAG"| temporalQueue
    temporalQueue -.->|"Executes"| dagWorker
    dagWorker -.->|"Wholesale: Video"| tierOneApis
    dagWorker -.->|"ElevenLabs: Audio"| audioApis
    dagWorker -->|"Soul ID DoP"| gpuRunner
    dagWorker -->|"Transcodes LOD"| mediaWorker
    gpuRunner -->|"Stores Weights"| r2Storage
    mediaWorker -->|"Writes MP4 WebP"| r2Storage

board3_dag_wallet_sequence.name: Open-DreamFlow Chained DAG and Atomic Wallet Sequence
board3_dag_wallet_sequence.userIntent: Trace end-to-end execution of a chained Image-to-Video DAG node through atomic credit hold, Soul ID or wholesale API execution, Cloudflare R2 upload, and capture settlement.
board3_dag_wallet_sequence.mermaidSyntax:
sequenceDiagram
    title Chained DAG Execution and Atomic Credit Settlement
    participant CreatorCanvas
    participant APIGateway
    participant CreditLedger
    participant DAGOrchestrator
    participant KlingOrGPU
    participant CloudflareR2

    CreatorCanvas->>APIGateway: POST /api/generate-node DAG
    APIGateway->>CreditLedger: Hold estimated wholesale cost
    CreditLedger-->>APIGateway: Hold ID locked or BYOK $0
    APIGateway->>DAGOrchestrator: Enqueue Image to Video chain
    DAGOrchestrator->>KlingOrGPU: Step 1 Soul ID Image render
    KlingOrGPU-->>DAGOrchestrator: Return image bytes
    DAGOrchestrator->>CloudflareR2: Upload lossless PNG and WebP LOD
    CloudflareR2-->>DAGOrchestrator: CDN URL ready
    DAGOrchestrator->>KlingOrGPU: Step 2 Kling 4.0 DoP video
    KlingOrGPU-->>DAGOrchestrator: Return MP4 clip
    DAGOrchestrator->>CloudflareR2: Write faststart MP4 206 stream
    DAGOrchestrator-->>CreditLedger: Capture exact provider cost
    CreditLedger-->>CreatorCanvas: WebSocket node ready and receipt
